categories.main_business_segments: Hubei Doti Micro Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the precision optical components industry, focusing on imaging optical components and communication optical components. Imaging components include infrared cut-off filters, prisms, and biometric recognition filters used in smartphone camera modules, automotive cameras, and security cameras. Communication components include GPON filters, TO caps, WDM filters, z-block components, and optical isolators used in optical communication devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as optical design, vacuum evaporation coating, magnetron sputtering coating, semiconductor spin coating, glass cold processing, mold manufacturing, multi-cavity hot pressing, cutting, silk printing, bonding, welding, and assembly. It uses advanced equipment from Germany and Japan to produce ultraviolet, visible, near-infrared, and far-infrared filters with ultra-narrow bandwidths and ultra-hard metal films. The production model includes flexible manufacturing for customized imaging components and standardized production with inventory for communication components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic smartphone brands and camera module manufacturers, particularly in the Android smartphone market, automotive electronics companies focusing on ADAS and intelligent driving cameras, security and surveillance system providers, and optical communication equipment manufacturers. The company serves markets in consumer electronics, automotive electronics, security monitoring, and optical communication transmission.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with production bases in Central China (Hubei), South China (Guangdong), and East China (Jiangxi). Its sales are predominantly domestic, with a small portion of revenue from overseas markets. The headquarters is located in Dangyang City, Hubei Province, with offices also in Dongguan, Guangdong Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hubei Doti Micro Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of precision optical components that are supplied to downstream module integrators and end-product manufacturers such as smartphone and automotive camera producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological leadership and product innovation, focusing on breakthroughs in complex optical components like glued prisms, aspheric lenses, and ultra-thin filters. It is advancing semiconductor optical processing technologies such as nanoimprinting and etching. R&D priorities include laser radar optical components, Z-block wavelength division multiplexing components, optical isolators, and micro-prisms for smartphones. The company also invests in digital transformation and automation to enhance manufacturing efficiency and plans to pursue strategic acquisitions in frontier optical technologies and emerging applications like AR/VR, lidar, and AI robotics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of optical components, including customized imaging optical components and standardized communication optical components. The company signs framework agreements with customers and fulfills orders based on demand, recognizing revenue at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position domestically in infrared cut-off filters, especially in the high-end smartphone segment, and ranks among the top in GPON filters and TO caps in the optical communication sector. It competes in a highly competitive market with increasing industry investment and technological innovation, maintaining advantages through scale, technology, and deep customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 597 million, a 69.2% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 55.8 million, a 271% increase. The company has shown strong growth momentum, expanding production capacity and market share, with total assets exceeding RMB 1.3 billion and net assets around RMB 856 million at year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced optical coating and processing technologies, enabling production of ultra-thin, high-performance optical filters and complex optical components like micro-prisms and aspheric lenses. Its strong R&D capabilities and flexible manufacturing allow it to meet high precision and customization demands, supporting leading domestic smartphone brands and communication equipment manufacturers. The company’s scale, quality control, and integrated digital management systems ensure reliable delivery and cost efficiency, reinforcing its competitive edge.
